notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Quest System Update
notes.notes:

 Introduced a new Quest System: The Mastermind character now gives you quests with rewards upon completion.
 Added a new intro sequence to the game. Yee!!!

🔧 Changed

 Separated the Tutorial button from the Play button.
 Reorganized the main menu layout.
